# Astryx blog review

Read and apply the canonical [Blog Review Rubric](https://github.com/meta/astryx/wiki/Blog-Review-Rubric#three-required-scored-criteria) before reviewing. Do not copy its criteria or scoring definitions into this file.

Use the post's declared type profile, verify checkable claims against the current branch, and apply the rubric's accuracy gate before scoring the prose.
